{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check for QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check revenue column type and examples
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First 5 revenue values (as strings): {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")"}
